message.content:
Here’s a classic set of ingredients you’ll typically find in a traditional lasagna:

| Category | Typical Items |
|----------|---------------|
| **Pasta** | Lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) |
| **Meat Sauce** | Ground beef or Italian sausage, onion, garlic, crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce, tomato paste, olive oil, salt, pepper, dried oregano, dried basil, red pepper flakes (optional), bay leaf |
| **Cheese Layer** | Ricotta cheese, shredded mozzarella, grated Parmesan, egg (for binding ricotta), fresh parsley or basil (optional) |
| **Vegetable Option** | Sautéed spinach, zucchini, mushrooms, bell peppers, or eggplant (optional) |
| **Seasonings & Extras** | Salt, black pepper, sugar (to balance acidity), extra virgin olive oil, fresh herbs (parsley, basil, thyme) |

Feel free to adjust quantities based on your taste and dietary preferences!
